units.source_text: 由这句话我也知道了先生和夫人之间发生的风波，并不是什么大不了的事。

en.t: From those words I also understood that the disturbance between Sensei and his wife was not anything very serious.

units.source_text: 后来不断出入先生家，我也大致推测出，那种情况是极少发生的。

en.t: Later, as I kept going in and out of Sensei's house, I could also roughly infer that such things happened very rarely.

units.source_text: 而且，有一回先生竟然对我发出了这样的感慨：

en.t: Moreover, on one occasion Sensei even expressed this thought to me:

units.source_text: “这个世上，我只知道一个女人，

en.t: "In this world, I know only one woman,

units.source_text: 那就是我的妻子，其他女子都不会使我动心。

en.t: and that is my wife; no other woman moves my heart.

units.source_text: 妻子也认定我是天下唯一的男人。

en.t: My wife, too, believes that I am the only man in the world.

units.source_text: 从某种意义上说，我们天生应该是最幸福的一对。”

en.t: In a certain sense, we ought to have been born the happiest pair."

units.source_text: 现在，我已经忘记了我们当时在谈论什么，所以，也说不清先生为什么对我作这样的坦白。

en.t: Now I have forgotten what we were discussing at the time, so I cannot say why Sensei made such a confession to me.

units.source_text: 但是，先生认真的神色和深沉的语调，至今还留在我的记忆中。

en.t: But Sensei's earnest expression and deep tone of voice remain in my memory even now.

units.source_text: 当时，在我耳中产生异样回响的是最后那句“天生应该是最幸福的一对”。

en.t: At the time, what sounded strangely in my ears was the final phrase, 'we ought to have been born the happiest pair.'

units.source_text: 先生为什么不说肯定是幸福的，而说成应该是呢？

en.t: Why did Sensei say not that they were certainly happy, but that they ought to be?

units.source_text: 这一点令我产生了疑问。
尤其是先生说这句话时加重了语气，就更令我费解了。

en.t: Especially because Sensei emphasized those words as he said them, I found it even harder to understand.

units.source_text: 我不能不猜测，先生是否真的幸福，难道说应该幸福却不那么幸福？

en.t: I could not help wondering whether Sensei was truly happy, or whether he ought to be happy yet was not quite so happy after all.

units.source_text: 这不能不让我满腹狐疑。

en.t: This could not help filling me with suspicion.

units.source_text: 但是，这种疑惑也只是转瞬之间的事，很快就被我忘记了。

en.t: But that doubt lasted only a moment, and I soon forgot it.
